description: Kerala has always been a pioneer in adopting technology for governance, from e-literacy to e-governance
body_lead: Policy Update Ashi Verma Background Kerala has always been a pioneer in adopting technology for governance, from e-literacy to e-governance. To take this legacy forward, the Government of Kerala launched the Kerala Artificial Intelligence Mission (K-AIM) in 2024 under the Kerala Development and Innovation Strategic Council (K-DISC). K-AIM is Keralas’ dedicated mission to make Artificial Intelligence a core tool for transparent, efficient and citizen-centric governance. The vision is not just to use AI, but to build an AI-ready Kerala.
